reviewer_role: independent QA with security, data, and product review
independence: The reviewer did not author the M55 implementation and did not rely on author confidence as evidence.

candidate.state: exact current uncommitted M55 candidate bytes

verdict.summary: The hash-bound candidate passes the bounded local, synthetic, single-fixture evidence-intake milestone. It does not establish customer-document, hosted-service, production, deployment, merge, or release readiness.

checks.name: focused_m55_gate
checks.evidence: 40 tests and 176 assertions: database 18/101, API workspace 15/53, browser boundary 7/22.

checks.name: static_quality_and_production_build
checks.evidence: API, web, and database type checks passed; web lint passed; Vite production build passed. The existing engine chunk produced a non-blocking size warning.

checks.name: production_bundle_exclusion
checks.evidence: The final production dist contained zero matches for M54/M55 synthetic tokens, PDF filename, account/bill identifiers, correction reason, fixed quantities, M55 flag, and workspace bill route.

checks.name: database_authorization_and_integrity
checks.evidence: All seven M55 tables reported enabled and forced RLS and authenticated read-only table ACLs. The three write functions reported SECURITY DEFINER, search_path=neuvetra, pg_temp, no PUBLIC execution, and authenticated execution. Tests exercised auth.uid identity, owner/admin writes, member read-only access, outsider invisibility, foreign facility/boundary refusal, direct mutation refusal, same-digest tenant independence, and bounded derived stores.

checks.name: immutable_fixture_and_lineage
checks.evidence: The 4,605-byte PDF SHA-256 is 0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135. Manifest, parser, database exact-byte comparison, persisted rehash, version 1, corrected version 2, and version-pinned 12.346000 MWh draft link agree. Altered bytes with a falsely claimed pinned digest are rejected before persistence.

checks.name: duplicate_and_atomic_behavior
checks.evidence: Constraint-backed intake/correction/link convergence produced one lineage under three concurrent calls; replay returned the existing IDs. Workspace plus fixed role seeding rolls back as one transaction when membership seeding fails, and non-owner bootstrap creates no partial workspace.

checks.name: api_boundary
checks.evidence: Writes enforce trusted origin before auth/lookup, authenticate from bearer identity, reject extra or stale IDs/values, distinguish member 403 from inference-safe absent evidence 404, return idempotent repeated link results, and bound database and role-lookup exceptions without private details.

checks.name: browser_contract_storage_and_accessibility
checks.evidence: The browser decoder enforces the exact document identity, dates, locators, state/version graph, corrected value, and pinned draft value. Requests carry fixed synthetic bearer identities outside bodies. Local storage retains only opaque workspace/evidence UUIDs. Busy controls disable identity switching and duplicate submissions; errors use an assertive alert and move focus, while missing facility returns focus to the described checkbox.

checks.name: pdf_content_and_visual_inspection
checks.evidence: One unencrypted letter-size page, no JavaScript or form, visually legible with no clipping/overlap. It clearly labels itself fictional/no customer data and shows Synthetic Golden State Electric, SYNTHETIC-0001, SYN-CA-2023-01, January 1-31 2023, and 12,345 kWh. Exact source byte spans 3119:3147 and 3384:3394 resolve to the period and usage text.

findings.finding: Parser initially returned November dates while the frozen PDF and product contract required January.
findings.resolution: Parser, payload, response, UI, and tests now consistently use 2023-01-01 through 2023-01-31.

findings.finding: Database intake initially trusted the claimed digest and byte length rather than the supplied bytes.
findings.resolution: The write function now compares the supplied bytea to the complete pinned PDF bytes before any insert; an altered-byte direct-RPC test fails atomically.

findings.finding: Draft linkage initially did not prove included facility membership or the exact 2023 operational-control draft/version-1 boundary.
findings.resolution: The function now requires the exact tenant-scoped boundary attributes and an included boundary_facilities row.

findings.finding: An intermediate database adapter bypassed the authenticated role for M55 operations and failed execution grants.
findings.resolution: Bill operations now execute under the authenticated role with auth.uid-derived identity; executable ACL inspection and tests pass.

findings.finding: The API initially rejected an exact repeated link and did not bind correction/link commands to prior/current version IDs.
findings.resolution: Strict priorVersionId and billVersionId bodies, stale refusal, constraint-backed convergence, and idempotent replay tests are present.

findings.finding: The initial response and decoder omitted bill identity, service dates, and source locators and accepted inconsistent state/version graphs.
findings.resolution: The bounded response and browser decoder now require exact identity, January dates, byte locators, lineage states, corrected quantity, and draft pin.

findings.finding: Initial role coverage lacked administrator success, member read-only behavior, and ordinary UI identities.
findings.resolution: Fixed admin/member identities, tenant memberships, API behavior, browser controls, and database role tests were added.

findings.finding: Role lookup exceptions on correction/link initially escaped their bounded API error path.
findings.resolution: Role lookup now runs inside the protected block and injected private-detail tests prove bounded 503 responses.

findings.finding: Workspace creation and fixed membership seeding initially committed in separate transactions and could leave partial state.
findings.resolution: Fixed-role seeding now shares one transaction, the server restricts bootstrap to the fixed owner, and rollback/non-owner tests pass.

findings.finding: Initial UI wording implied Stage 4 and rejected actions did not move focus to an error summary.
findings.resolution: The UI now says M55 local development demonstration and provides focused alert/field error behavior.

findings.finding: The milestone initially called the write-only database summary cache an improvement over the null-cache proposal.
findings.resolution: The record now calls it an isolation-only variance and states cache-hit/performance behavior is unmeasured.

findings.finding: A status-only draft embedded the previous review artifact hash inside a file bound by that artifact, creating a stale self-reference after rebind.
findings.resolution: The milestone now records the independent pass and artifact scope without embedding the mutable artifact hash; the final hash is retained externally in publication evidence.

findings.finding: The exact admitted fixture has no reachable terminal failed-extraction database row; changed and parser-inconsistent bytes are rejected before persistence.
findings.disposition: Explicitly disclosed in the milestone record. Acceptable only for this single exact fixture; persisted failure and retry lifecycle remain required before arbitrary or customer document intake.

findings.finding: PGlite and database-backed byte storage do not prove hosted PostgreSQL/Supabase or object-storage policy compatibility.
findings.disposition: Explicitly excluded from this local milestone. Hosted validation is a future gate.

findings.finding: The fixed hash-gated PDF parser does not support arbitrary PDFs, OCR, malware scanning, customer documents, or general utility formats.
findings.disposition: The UI, manifest, and milestone disclose the synthetic single-fixture boundary; all other bytes fail closed.

limitations: The review covers exact uncommitted local bytes and one deterministic fixture only.
No hosted PostgreSQL/Supabase, object storage, durable worker, scale, retention/deletion, disaster recovery, or production authentication was exercised.
No customer data, model/provider, OCR, network service, factor selection, emissions calculation, filing, assurance, merge, deployment, publication, or release was used or authorized.
The database-backed summary cache is write-only in M55; cache-hit and performance behavior are unmeasured.
The production build emitted an existing engine chunk size warning; the build passed and the M55 exclusion scan was clean.
